paite: "Ngai in, ka sawltak ka sawl a, ama'n ka ma ah lampi abawlkhol ding a TOUPA, na zon uh, atempul ah thakhat in ahong pai ding; na kipahna uh, thukhun sawltak, ngai un, ahong hi," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
heading: Hong Pai Ding TOUPA Sawltak
english: “Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me! The Lord, whom you seek, will suddenly come to his temple. Behold, the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, is coming!” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Himahleh ahong paina ni kua'n athuakzou thei dia? Ahong lat chiang in kua adingzou dia? Amah hihsiangthou meikuang leh puansawptu sahbon bang ahi ngal a.
english: “But who can endure the day of his coming? And who will stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and like launderers’ soap;

paite: Huchi in dangka hihsiangthoumi leh siangsakmi bang in atu ding a Levi tapate ahihsiang ding hi, dangka-eng leh dangka bang in amau akhuahsiang ding a, huchi in diktatna in TOUPA kiang ah thillatte alan ding uhi.
english: and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi, and refine them as gold and silver; and they shall offer to Yahweh offerings in righteousness.

paite: Huai chiang in Judah leh Jerusalem thillatte nidanglai bang leh tang a kumte bang in TOUPA a ding in namtui ahi ding hi.
english: Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasant to Yahweh as in the days of old and as in ancient years.

paite: "Huan vaihawmna ah aisan mite kalh in, angkawmte kalh in, zuau a kichiamte kalh in theihpihpa kin ka hi ding a, loh thu a migoih, meithai, pabei, nuaisiah, athuneihna a kipan mikhual kaiheipa, kei hon kihtaloute kalh in, na kiang uah ka hong ding sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will come near to you to judgment. I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, against the adulterers, against the perjurers, and against those who oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and don’t fear me,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: "Kei TOUPA ka zulhzau kei a; huaiziak in Jakob tapate aw, haltum in na om kei uhi.
heading: Sawm-a-khat Piak Ding
english: “For I, Yahweh, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.

paite: Na pipute uh dam lai a kipan ka dan thupiakte na kilehheisan ua, na zui kei uhi. Ka kiang ah hong kik unla, na kiang uah ka hong kik ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Himahleh nou, koi ah i kik ding ua? na chi uhi.
english: From the days of your fathers you have turned away from my ordinances and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will return to you,” says Yahweh of Armies. “But you say, ‘How shall we return?’

paite: Mi'n Pathian alok diam? Hinapi in noute'n na hon lok uh. Himahleh bangchidan in ka hon lok ua eita? na chi uhi. Sawm-a-khatte ah leh thillatte ah.
english: Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings.

paite: Hiai nam pumpi in, kei na hon loh ziak un hamsiatna a hamsiat na hi uhi.
english: You are cursed with the curse; for you rob me, even this whole nation.

paite: Ka insung a an ahong omtheihna ding in koihkhawmna inn ah sawm-a-khat avek in hon lalut unla, huai in kei hon entel un, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Akoihna ding dantan kiching om lou khop in van tohlette hong in, vualzawlna ka hon buakkhe kei na hiam!
english: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this,” says Yahweh of Armies, “if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there will not be enough room for.

paite: Huan negaimi pen nou ziak in ka sal ding a, na leigahte uh ahihse kei ding hi; na grepgui uh leng lou ah ahun tun ma in agah akesak kei ding hi, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast its fruit before its time in the field,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huchi in nam tengteng in nang nuamsa ahon chi ding ua; gam deihhuai na hih ding ziak un, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “All nations shall call you blessed, for you will be a delightful land,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: "Kei dem a na thute uh akhauh hi," TOUPA'N achi, "Nou koi ah nang dem in thu ka gen ua eita," na chi uh.
heading: TOUPA Dem A Thugenna
english: “Your words have been harsh against me,” says Yahweh. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’

paite: "Pathian nasep athawn ahi, athupiak i zuih ua, suunna puan silh a sepaihte' TOUPA ma a i om uh bang ahia aphattuamna, na chi uh.
english: You have said, ‘It is vain to serve God,’ and ‘What profit is it that we have followed his instructions and that we have walked mournfully before Yahweh of Armies?

paite: Tu in kisatheite nuamsa chi in agitlouhna nasemte tunding in a-om uh; ahi; Pathian khemte hotkhiak in a-om uh," i chi uhi.
english: Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.’

paite: TOUPA kihtate akihoupih ua; huchi in TOUPA'N angaikhia a, aza a, TOUPA kihta a, amin ngaihtuahte ama ah, theihgigena laibuzial ah gelh ahi.
english: Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened and heard, and a book of memory was written before him for those who feared Yahweh and who honored his name.

paite: "Huan amau kei a ahi ding ua, gou lamdangtak ka bawl ni chiang in," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Mi'n ama nasem atapa ahawi bang in huchi in amau ka hawi ding hi.
english: They shall be mine,” says Yahweh of Armies, “my own possession in the day that I make. I will spare them, as a man spares his own son who serves him.

paite: Huai hun chiang in na hong kihei ding ua, diktatte leh giloute, Pathian nasem leh ama nna semloute kal na khenchian thei ding uhi.
english: Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t serve him.
